sources.description: Artifact table identifies location- and drop-specific sources.
Trove contains 27 possible outputs; Blacksmith opens for 25g; Desert Trader exchanges 5 Omni Geodes.
Individual geode mineral table and geode processing requirements.
1.6 crusher consumes no coal; recipe from Cave Patrol; requires 2 Gold Bars, 50 Stone, 1 Diamond.
Smelting consumes five of each ore and one coal; Quartz and Fire Quartz alternative for Refined Quartz.
Seasonal foraging, berry dates, beach/mines/Ginger Island contexts.
Fruit trees mature after 28 days; saplings, seasons, island/greenhouse variants.
Adult/fed animal production and probabilistic large produce based on mood and friendship.
Preserves jar turns vegetables into pickles, fruit into jelly, roe into aged roe and sturgeon roe into caviar.
